about: Words with which Playwright or the browser says that the browser, or one of its processes, went away under a test, as scripts/ci/e2e-report.mjs reads them. `alone`: true when the words prove a browser crash by themselves; false when Playwright also says them without any crash (a page, context or browser the test or its teardown closed), so they count only beside a sign that is sufficient alone, in the same attempt and before its failure. Only wordings seen in this repository's CI are listed, each with a run where it was seen.
